sentences.en: The urge to brag on his recent successes was irresistible.
sentences.zh: 他想炫耀最近取得的成绩的冲动无法抑制。

sentences.en: Skura's wild ways were an irresistible honey trap for men.
sentences.zh: 斯库拉那放荡不羁的方式对男人有着无法抗拒的诱惑。

sentences.en: Love is an irresistible desire to be irresistibly desired.
sentences.zh: 爱就是一种无法抗拒的欲望，想要被别人同样强烈地渴望。

senses.zh: 无法抗拒的,诱惑人的，具有非常的魅力的,不可抗拒,不可阻挡
